Here is my first holo of year 2007.

It's quite dim but fairly deep. The blurred cube is floating at about 3 cm from the glass surface, while the ball in the upper left corner is 3 cm deep.

posts.author: JohnFP
posts.content_md:
Ahhh, image planed hologram. I love image planed holograms with an object floating in front of the plate. 

Christiano, did you get the floating cube by doing a proximity copy of a reflection hologram? That is, a reflection H2 from a reflection H1?

In your last post of the balls and cubes the image is nearly white. This can work very well for a proximity copy in DCG I have found. It is easier to do a proximity copy of a white reflection hologram then trying to tune exactly the narrow band reflection master to your wavelength.
